title: EAgraphics
text: Jacob Burbank 2026-02-05

title: EAgraphics
text: EAgraphics package provides suite user-friendly functions designed visualize data indicators frequently utilized Ecosystem Approaches (EA) Fisheries Management. Initially developed visualization companion Gulf St. Lawrence Ecosystem Approaches (gslea) R package (https://github.com/duplisea/gslea), EAgraphics built flexible. integrates seamlessly gslea data structures, equally capable visualizing EA-relevant datasets follow standard long-format conventions.

title: EAgraphics
text: View functions capabilities package website: https://jakeburb.github.io/EAgraphics/index.html functions organized 5 main categories: Environmental Indicators, Biological Indicators, Fisheries Indicators, Anomaly Analysis, Functions

title: EAgraphics
text: -Publication-Quality Figures: Standardized plotting physical oceanography (temperature, ice dynamics), biological metrics (phytoplankton phenology, zooplankton abundance), fisheries data. -Integrated Trend Analysis: Simplified implementation Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) annual trend lines distinguish inter-annual variability long-term ecosystem shifts. -Bilingual Reporting: Full support English French outputs. Using internal dictionaries rosettafish package (https://github.com/pbs-assess/rosettafish), EAgraphics automatically translates species names, region identifiers, complex scientific units. Translations need added internal dictionaries new terms areas used, therefore contact package maintainer add necessary (Jacob.Burbank@dfo-mpo.gc.ca) -Anomaly Visualization: Flexible functions computation visualization anomalies based user-defined baseline periods, essential identifying significant environmental departures. -Fisheries Status Monitoring: Specialized heatmap visualizations designed show stock status relative Limit Reference Points (LRP), ensuring consistent stock ordering clear threshold demarcations across languages.

title: EAgraphics
text: Ecosystem Approach data often multi-faceted spatially complex. package reduces “coding overhead” required produce consistent figures across multiple indicators. Whether comparing sea surface temperature across different Ecosystem Assessment Regions (EARs) visualizing status multiple fish stocks simultaneously, EAgraphics ensures output standardized, reproducible, ready technical reports peer-reviewed publications. Also line billinguial requirements DFO Res Docs, package provides ability rapidly easily produce figures english french.
